title: Introduce compact RAG Playwright integration and local scenario recorder
author: Priya Nambiar
release_notes: Add a compact Playwright-based RAG integration for end-to-end local scenario recording and replay. Useful for developer onboarding, regression tests, and telemetry-driven quality checks.
description: Motivation: Developers frequently ask for a small, reproducible harness that demonstrates RAG workflows end-to-end in a browser context while capturing deterministic telemetry for local debugging and CI. This PR introduces a lightweight Playwright integration plus a local scenario recorder that can capture step-by-step interactions, network stubs, and RAG tool calls for later replay or CI assertions. --- What this changes: added a new example app (examples/rag-playwright) that runs a tiny React UI and a Node-based recorder; a Playwright test suite that exercises common RAG scenarios (search->tool-call->compose->verify); devcontainer + npm scripts to run recorder and replay flows; documentation and a short Quickstart on how to record scenarios, attach telemetry to Redwood Console, and produce reproducible regression tests. --- Checklist: [x] Add example app and recorder runtime; [x] Add Playwright test harness and sample scenarios; [x] Document developer Quickstart and recorder API; [x] Hook basic telemetry events to the recorder for token/latency traces; [x] CI smoketest that replays recorded scenarios. --- Links: demo GIF + usage guide in README, local playback CLI docs at /docs/local-playback, related Linear ENG-4129. This description includes the end-to-end motivation, usage notes, and where to find artifacts in the tree.
commits: feat(rag-playwright): add minimal React UI and recorder runtime
test(playwright): add scenario recordings and e2e tests
chore(devcontainer): add devcontainer and npm entrypoints for recorder
docs: add Quickstart and usage examples for recorder and replay CLI
fix(ci): increase timeout for playback step flakiness
review_comments: Ethan Park: Nice compact harness — can we keep the recorder lightweight and avoid bundling heavyweight deps? Suggest switching to esbuild for the recorder build step.
Priya Nambiar: Switched recorder build to esbuild and reduced bundle size ~70%. Kept playback CLI as a Node script with minimal deps.
Marisol Vega: Docs look good. Please add guidance for anonymizing telemetry before committing recordings to repo.
Priya Nambiar: Added anonymization notes and a small scrub tool in examples/shared/telemetry/scrub.js
Jonas Kline: CI flaked once on Windows runners; suggested increasing Playwright timeouts and adding retry on flaky step.
Priya Nambiar: Increased timeout and added a one-time retry for the network stub step; CI passed on rerun.
testing_notes: Playwright suite includes three sample scenarios (basic-rag, tool-failover, cached-kv-replay). Recordings stored under examples/rag-playwright/fixtures and referenced by tests. Local recorder emits a small JSON event stream with event types: INPUT/SEARCH/CALL/RESPONSE/CACHE_HIT which the replay harness consumes for deterministic assertions.
how_to_use: 1) yarn install && yarn start in examples/rag-playwright to launch UI and recorder; 2) open /recorder in the UI and hit record while exercising RAG flows; 3) save recording to fixtures and run yarn replay to verify; 4) CI uses .github/workflows/playwright-smoketest.yml to replay canonical fixtures and assert no regressions.
notes_for_reviewers: Focus review on: minimal surface area of recorder runtime, telemetry schema stability, and CI reliability knobs. This PR deliberately avoids embedding production telemetry keys and documents privacy/scrubbing steps.
impact: improves developer onboarding and makes regression testing for RAG scenarios straightforward; small telemetry hooks allow linking local recordings to Redwood Console snapshots for easier triage.
